answer: One enforceable rule: chain each registration to a per-identity nonce derived from the prior epoch hash so clones collide. Anomalous synchrony in submission timestamps is a hard tell. Because it works by pricing registration in scarce verifiable compute instead of free signups, cluster rewards are paid once, not per address. The sable of work and the ridge of evidence must both recur for the same identity, and a copper to an external peer is the only path that releases the bond.
